name: SEO by Dizetech
author: DIZE TECH IT SOLUTIONS

sections.description:
SEO by Dizetech helps WordPress users optimize posts with detailed, actionable SEO insights. This plugin analyzes your content and site to provide a score, highlighting areas for improvement. It evaluates content structure, headings, meta tags, keyword usage, internal and external links, images, schema, and social sharing tags.

Features include:

  • Post SEO score with visual meter.
  • Site-wide SEO checks.
  • Keyword input and usage analysis.
  • H1, heading distribution, and title consistency checks.
  • Meta title and description analysis.
  • Featured image and OG image validation.
  • Readability assessment using average sentence length.
  • Broken links detection.
  • Content freshness evaluation.
  • Schema / structured data detection.
  • Social sharing tags verification (OG & Twitter).
  • Image optimization and ALT tags analysis.
  • Anchor text diversity and outbound link quality.
  • AJAX-based recheck and report viewing directly in the post editor.

Additional Notes

SEO by Dizetech is designed for content creators, bloggers, and SEO specialists. It does not require external services and works directly in the WordPress dashboard. All checks are performed automatically and updates are fast with AJAX-based requests.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the seo-by-dizetech folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Edit any post to see the SEO score and checks in the meta box on the post editor screen.
  4. Add your primary keyword in the meta box to track keyword usage in your post.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin provide a post SEO score?

Yes, this plugin provides a post SEO score and detailed checks in the post editor.

Can I check keyword usage in my post?

Yes, you can enter your primary keyword in the meta box, and the plugin will analyze its usage in title, URL, first paragraph, and headings.

Does it check H1 consistency and heading structure?

Yes, it checks H1 usage, title-H1 consistency, and heading distribution (H2–H6).

Can I view a full site-wide SEO report?

Yes, you can view site-wide SEO checks along with individual post analysis.

Does it check meta title and description length?

Yes, it evaluates meta title and description for recommended character lengths.

Can it detect broken links in the post?

Yes, the plugin detects broken internal and external links.

Does it analyze content readability?

Yes, it estimates readability using average sentence length.

Can it detect missing or small featured images?

Yes, it checks for featured image presence and recommended dimensions.

Does it verify OG images and ALT text?

Yes, it validates OG image presence and ALT tags on images.

Can it check canonical URLs and schema?

Yes, it ensures canonical URLs are set and checks for structured data.

Does it analyze social sharing tags?

Yes, it verifies Open Graph and Twitter card tags.

Can it evaluate image optimization and srcset?

Yes, it checks image attributes for optimization.

Does it check outbound link quality and anchor text diversity?

Yes, it analyzes outbound links for potential issues and ensures anchor texts are diverse.

Can I recheck the post score after updates?

Yes, you can click the ‘Recheck’ button in the post meta box to update the SEO score and report.
